name: Ragdoll Fight [NEW]
desc:
Invent your own moves! Kick, punch, grab, or tear your opponent apart by controlling your fighter's limbs directly. Set up each move, then watch the physics play it out.

 - Turn-based 1v1 fights against real players, ranked or casual
 - MMA, Judo, Swords and Jousting game modes
 - Earn belts to unlock new fighting styles, from Sumo to Gorilla
 - Season pass, crates and cosmetics: trails, auras, celebrations and more
 - Spectate live fights and play with friends
 - Climb the challenge leaderboards
 - Save and rewatch your best fights

Inspired by Toribash.

llm.loop: set up limb moves turn by turn -> watch physics resolve the fight -> win 1v1 ranked matches -> earn belts for new styles
llm.progression: belts, fighting styles, season pass, cosmetics
llm.instructions: control limbs directly, set moves, watch physics; ranked or casual
unique: Toribash-style turn-based limb-control fighting on Roblox
llm.thumbnails: two ragdoll fighters with blood splatter on an arena disc
llm.complexity_notes: articulated ragdoll physics, turn system, replays, ranked
